decision: break_credit_multiplier defaults to 3.0 in the standard ergonomic profile and 2.0 in default, relaxed, strict and demo; the struct fallback stays 2.0
rationale: 3.0 gives a 45 min sit : 15 min break ratio, which matches how the owner actually works; the other profiles keep their existing pace

decision: current_session_secs is deleted from SessionState, SessionStateDto and StateChangedPayload; the Debug tab alone gets secs_since_last_break, and no timer, bar, colour or notification may read it
rationale: the popup timer read the uncredited counter and dropped to zero on every return to sitting, contradicting the break credit the engine had applied; deleting the field makes the compiler enforce one credited counter instead of a convention

decision: E015 ships before the public release (E017)
rationale: the visible symptom is a timer that resets on standing; shipping a release with it teaches users the wrong model

decision: MoveUp is released under the MIT licence; LICENSE at the repo root carries the standard MIT text with copyright holder "Paweł Żentała", and the same licence is declared in package.json and src-tauri/Cargo.toml
rationale: the open-core model keeps the desktop app itself open and sells the cloud/AI layer, so the app needs a permissive licence that lets anyone build, fork and ship it; MIT is the shortest such licence and the one the surrounding ecosystem already assumes

decision: ts-rs generates the TypeScript mirror of every Rust DTO into src/generated/; src/types.ts and SettingsTypes.ts re-export it, and E015's fixture-based drift test is deleted
rationale: hand-typed mirrors drifted silently - the codegen immediately exposed three live drifts (TodaySummary missing three fields, SessionEntry typing a nullable duration as number and omitting break_credit, DeskSettings still declaring five fields that moved to the profiles); a compile error is stronger than a runtime key-set diff. specta was rejected as a larger commitment: its value is generating invoke() command bindings, which means rewiring every call site
scope: src-tauri DTO structs, src/generated/, src/types.ts, src/components/settings/SettingsTypes.ts
